newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 27.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 27. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The House of Representatives has approved the bill on nuclear power, which allows the Indonesian government to build nuclear plant when necessary.
A research suggests that civil servants should be allowed to join any political organisation. Indonesian civil servants are only allowed to vote for the ruling Golkar party.
PT International Timber Corporation Indonesia (ITCI) plans to set up a $500 million pulp factory in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan.
City councillors will summon north Jakarta mayor after six islands had submerged in the "Thousand Islands" -- a cluster of small islands which are part of the north Jakarta mayoralty.
